name: bobby-pin
description: A bobby pin with one wavy arm and one straight arm joined at the rounded end.
useCase: Identify bobby pins or small hair fastening tools.
misuse: Use a visible label when a tool identifies a product or a specific grooming task.

16.reason: The full wavy arm stays clear of the straight arm around the rounded join.

24.reason: The larger pin keeps its complete wavy and straight arms separate.
